Original pilot area. Saturday slots are taken first; offer a weekday where the customer is flexible.
Original pilot area. Steep drives: the van parks on the road and the customer should expect equipment to be carried up.
Largest crew outside the pilot areas.
Served from the Northcaster depot. Morning window is rarely free; offer the two later windows first.

Kestrel & Vane head depot. Also holds the spare ladder crew that covers Sablecrest on request.
Unsurfaced roads beyond the ridge; the partner may telephone the customer for directions.
Friday slots close at noon on the Wednesday before.
Reached by the causeway; visits are not booked into the 8 am window.
Paused while the partner is short of crew. Visits already booked go ahead; take no new bookings until the status returns to Live.
Newest live area; one crew. Tell the customer the first date the calendar shows and nothing earlier.

Many flats: ask whether the building allows fixings on outside walls before booking an Eave Cam.

Target opening January 2027; not announced to customers.

Level crossing closures can delay the crew; the arrival window still applies.
Harbour-side terraces: no vehicle access after 10 am on market days so the partner prefers the first window.
Crew recruitment under way.

column3: core = no travel fee. outer = the travel fee in travel_fee_usd is added once for the visit however many cameras are fitted.
Live = bookable. Paused = no new bookings for now. Planned = not open; no bookings and no visits.
The day the first visits were carried out in the area (year-month-day).
The days of the week on which the partner works in the area.
Calendar days between the day of booking and the first day the calendar can offer.
Distance from the depot inside which an address belongs to the area. An address outside every radius cannot be booked.
yes = the area has a ladder crew and a camera can be fixed above the height given in the Installation Service Guide.
